title: places details summary record (v1)
description: The terminal summary record of one completed places details walk: the invocation's id count, the returned and missing position counts of the order reconstruction, and the chunk request counts beside the latest response's identifiers. It follows the streamed per-id result records of every completed chunk.

id_count.$comment: The number of ids the invocation asked about, duplicates included.

returned_count.$comment: The input positions whose id the responses carried.

missing_count.$comment: The input positions rendered as placeholders — missing or expired ids.

requested_requests.$comment: The chunk request count the invocation fans out into: the ceiling of id count over twenty.
